items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: And then came Jess Stacy, who played in the big band with Goodman, and of course Teddy Wilson

ctx.x: Well, certainly your piano style goes beyond the ragtime realm. What have any other pianists of the swing era or the modern era influence your playing as it's constituted today?

I think that the first real impact that hit me, when I say impact, I was already going under the influence of the old timers like Jelly Roll and the ragtime pianists. And I had one pianist around here by the name of Buzzy Williams, who was very, very excellent, and he gave me a lot of encouragement and a lot of help. But getting back to the other pianists, I would say that the first one that really had a terrific impact on me was Earl Hines. I think that he did more to revolutionize my style of playing probably…
Did you take up, were you taken up much by Art Tatum's style?
